defect: the committed packages/mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin/dist/index.js (and 12 other dists that inline it) were never rebuilt after 7a8d245 added the adapter's live-session plane, so mpd_team_compact_run crashed with 'dsh.liveAgent is not a function' in every session mounting the row
mechanism: packages/mpd-bundle/cordis.patch.yml:146 loads the adapter DIST; 7a8d245 (2026-09-14 10:59) added liveAgents/liveAgent/compactionEngineForAgent/onEvent to src/index.ts but the dist dates from 455d376 (2026-09-11 18:05); bun build inlines the adapter source into every plugin dist, so one changed dependency invalidated 13 artifacts at once
fix: rebuild all 13 divergent dists with 'bun build packages/<pkg>/src/index.ts --target node --format esm --outfile packages/<pkg>/dist/index.js' from the repo root (the form that reproduces the committed banner byte-for-byte for an already-fresh package)
